news_week._note: Sunday refresh: News of the Week. Max 8 material items from the past Mon-Sun, grouped in this order: strategy (Strategy & Saylor), treasury (other big treasury companies: Strive/ASST, Metaplanet...), industry (index/regulatory/capital-markets news for the sector, other companies), bitcoin (price milestones, network, ETFs, adoption, crypto regulation) (omit a group with nothing material). One line each, date, official source preferred (SEC/TSE filing, company press release, regulator, index provider, Farside for ETF flows). BEFORE replacing, append the old news_week object to assets/data/news_archive.json weeks[] (newest first). Mark the 3 most material items with "top": 1 (shown when the card is collapsed). Each item also gets "why": one line, 'Why it matters for holders' (plain, factual, no advice). Mark the week's single biggest item "lead": 1 (the bold Top story; any group). 'On deck next week' is built automatically from desk.json week_ahead.
news_week.label: Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026

items.text: Stockholders approved daily dividends: STRC gets a record date every calendar day from Nov 1 (first payment Nov 2); STRF, STRK and STRD follow on Jan 1, 2027. Rates and totals are unchanged.
items.why: Holders of STRC now see income accrue daily instead of semi-monthly; the stated 12.00% rate for November is unchanged.

items.text: Q3 2026: operating income $20.91B (record, all from a digital-asset gain), net income $19.53B, diluted EPS $44.75. BTC Yield (3.7)% YTD, BTC Gain (24,947) BTC YTD, 848,517 BTC at $75,446 average cost (as of Oct 25).
items.why: The record operating income comes from the mark-to-market gain on bitcoin held; BTC Yield, Strategy's per-share bitcoin measure, is (3.7)% year to date.

items.text: No bitcoin bought or sold and no MSTR/preferred ATM sales Oct 19–25; repurchased 2,068,459 STRC shares for $204.9M from USD Cash. USD Reserve $4.83B, USD Cash $242.4M.
items.why: Holdings stayed at 848,517 BTC; the week's cash went to buying back STRC, which closed Oct 30 at $99.13 against its $100 par.

items.text: CFO Andrew Kang will resign effective Nov 5 for personal reasons; Phong Le acts as principal financial officer Nov 6 to Dec 31, then Reza Virasteh becomes CFO on Jan 1, 2027 as co-principal financial officer with Le.
items.why: A planned handover with named successors; the filing says the departure is not due to any disagreement with the company.

items.text: Strive bought 6,182 BTC (Oct 17–23, avg $82,732), taking holdings to 43,000 BTC; cash rose to $504.4M and 7,000,000 SATS preferred shares are now outstanding.
items.why: Strive now holds 43,000 BTC and ranks #4 on the Board, ahead of MARA.

items.text: Coinbase's 10-Q shows 17,954 BTC held for investment at Sep 30 (cost basis $1.26B, fair value $1.50B), up 643 BTC from 17,311 a quarter earlier.
items.why: Coinbase reports its bitcoin only quarterly, so the Board holding is as of Sep 30.

items.text: The Fed held its target range at 3.75–4.00% by a 10–2 vote. Next FOMC meeting Dec 8–9.
items.why: The policy rate is unchanged since Sep 17; see Macro backdrop for the real yield, curve, M2 and inflation behind it.

items.text: Binance's record $6.3B hack: the FBI attributed it to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit; Binance says it has replenished 90% of the stolen assets with company funds and plans to reopen withdrawals. Bitcoin traded near $77,065 on Oct 30, about 4% lower on the day.
items.why: A centralized-exchange breach, not a Bitcoin network failure; US spot BTC ETFs saw −$643M of net outflows on Oct 30 (Farside).
